title: Phase II Study of Pre-Operative Chemotherapy in Patients With Resectable Local-Regional Carcinoma of Esophagus
brief_summary: This study is designed pre-operative for patients with resectable, local-regional carcinoma of the esophagus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Measurable disease with resectable local-regional carcinoma of the esophagus. 18 years of age or older.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or lactating. Non-resectable local-regional carcinoma of the esophagus.
